# 증시흐름 (Market Brief AI)

> A static, daily AI morning market briefing for global investors.
> Hedge-fund morning-note structure, generated locally and published as plain HTML/JSON.

## What is this?
A free static website. Every morning a local Claude Code CLI run analyses global news
and market data, emits a structured JSON briefing, and a Python builder renders it into
static pages plus a machine-readable JSON API. There is no application server, no login,
and no tracking.

Each briefing follows a 7-part morning-note structure:
1. Overnight key events and market impact
2. Direction probability for the session (up / flat / down, summing to 100)
3. Sector leadership (leaders and laggards with ETFs)
4. Key risks with severity
5. Trade ideas with entry / target / stop / R:R
6. 10-second market dashboard
7. Portfolio note (owner-only, excluded from the public build by default)

## Features
- Structured daily briefing in Korean, with optional English / Chinese / Japanese passes
- Market snapshot: S&P 500, NASDAQ, Dow Jones, US 10Y, DXY, WTI, VIX, Gold, EUR/USD, BTC/USD, KOSPI, USD/KRW
- Prerendered sparklines plus interactive 1D / 5D / 1M charts
- Sector ETF performance (XLK, XLF, XLE, ...)
- CNN Fear & Greed Index gauge with prior close / 1-week / 1-month deltas
- Economic calendar: FOMC schedule with D-day and SEP flags, U.S. BLS indicator releases, major earnings
- Directional scorecard: each S&P 500 direction call is scored against the next session's close (hit rate + Brier)
- Cited source news with tier labels (T1 official, T2 verified, T3 wire)
- RSS feed, full archive, installable PWA, offline cache

## Machine-readable data
All paths are relative to the site root.
- data/index.json          — newest-first index of every published briefing
- data/latest.json         — the most recent briefing record in full
- data/briefings/<id>.json — one briefing record
- data/market.json         — latest market snapshot
- data/charts/<key>.json   — OHLC candles; key = <slug>_<1d|5d|1mo>
- data/scorecard.json      — directional scoring history
- feed.xml                 — RSS 2.0, last 20 briefings
- archive/index.html       — human-readable archive

## Data sources
Yahoo Finance, Finnhub, CNN Fear & Greed Index, Federal Reserve, U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics.

## Generation
Local Claude Code CLI (subscription quota, `claude -p` with a JSON schema). Optional API fallbacks.

## Disclaimer
AI-generated reference material. Not investment advice and not a solicitation to trade.
Probabilities, targets, and stop levels carry no guarantee of accuracy. Readers are solely
responsible for their own investment decisions.

## Target users
Retail investors, traders, and researchers who want a free, reproducible daily macro note.
